description: This file defines the IdConflictForm class for Drupal's migrate_drupal_ui module, handling the user interface for conflict detection during migration upgrades, including conflict reporting and warnings.

classes.name: IdConflictForm
classes.description: A form class for handling ID conflict detection and reporting during Drupal migration upgrades.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID string.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, performs conflict audits, and displays warnings or redirects based on results.

methods.name: conflictsForm
methods.description: Creates a section of the form listing conflicting content types and warnings.

methods.name: formatConflicts
methods.description: Formats audit conflict results into a list of labels.

methods.name: i18nWarningForm
methods.description: Creates a warning section for translation-related ID conflicts.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, setting the next step and redirecting.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the confirmation message for the form.
